description: Header file defining data structures, constants, and inline functions for managing pack objects in a version control system, including object entries, packing regions, and packing data.

methods.name: packing_data_lock
methods.description: Locks the mutex protecting the packing data's object database.

methods.name: packing_data_unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the mutex protecting the packing data's object database.

methods.name: oe_map_new_pack
methods.description: Maps a new pack into the packing data.

methods.name: oe_set_delta_ext
methods.description: Sets external delta information for an object entry.
